pkgmetadata.longdescription: Python wrapper that downloads and exposes the koalaman/shellcheck prebuilt binary as a pip-installable distribution. Intended for consumers that integrate shellcheck via the pre-commit framework or any Python tooling that resolves the `shellcheck` console entry point through distutils-installed data scripts. The package itself ships no Python module — the wheel produced by setuptools-download contains `shellcheck_py-${PV}.data/scripts/shellcheck`.
